title: Deploy requirements manifest, version 1
description: What must be true before an image may roll out. Built into the image and checked by a Sync hook before the pods roll. See README.md next to this file.

source_commit.description: Commit the image was built from, or null when the build does not know it.

digest.description: First 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the requirements list as compact JSON. Identifies the list in logs. Readers do not recompute it.

django.description: A Django migration that must be applied on the main Postgres.

replaces.description: Set when migration is a squash. Either the squash or every migration it replaces satisfies the requirement.

sqlx.description: sqlx migration versions that must be applied, and not recorded as failed, in one sqlx database.

database.description: The migrate-entry name of the database (rust/bin/migrate-entry).
